description: This file defines a TodoProvider class that manages the state of Todo items in a Flutter application. It interacts with a TodoDb class for database operations, handles CRUD actions on Todo objects, manages filtering and loading state, and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: TodoProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages Todo items, their filtering, and database interactions.

methods.name: TodoProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TodoProvider with an optional database instance.

methods.name: isLoading
methods.description: Getter indicating if a database operation is currently underway.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Getter for the current filter mode (all or completed).

methods.name: todos
methods.description: Getter returning the list of Todos after applying the current filter.

methods.name: loadTodos
methods.description: Asynchronous method to load all Todos from the database.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Method to update the current filter and notify listeners.

methods.name: addTodo
methods.description: Method to create and persist a new Todo item.

methods.name: editTodo
methods.description: Method to modify an existing Todo and save changes to the database.

methods.name: deleteTodo
methods.description: Method to remove a Todo from database and internal list.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Method to toggle the completion status of a Todo.
